system.description: A blood-red space outside the mortal world, linked by magic.
system.notes:
Mythic | Traversal

A blood-red space outside the mortal world, linked by magic.
Impulses: Pull off course, tempt with shortcuts, bleed them dry

Difficulty: 20

Features

Bleeding Steps - Passive: The air here smells of iron, and every step leaves a crimson trace. Travel requires a Progress Countdown (8) to reach the correct door. On a failure, a PC must mark a Stress in addition to the roll’s other consequences.

The Walkway Hungers - Action: Countdown (Loop 14). Activate the countdown. When it triggers, all PCs must succeed on a Charm Reaction Roll or temporarily lose 1d4 from their highest Trait unless they mark a number of Stress equal to its value. Lost Trait points are regained if the PC critically succeeds or exits the Walkway.

Dragged Off the Path - Action: The target makes a Wits (15) Reaction. On a failure, a PC takes 2d10 direct magic damage. On a success, they still mark a Stress.

Echoes of Blood - Reaction: On a result with Fear, ask the PC what memory or regret the Walkway forces them to relive. The PC loses a Hope. If it is their last Hope, you gain a Fear.
